text: There's a shark in the Arctic right now that may be older than the United States.
It's the Greenland shark. And it can live for around four hundred years.
Scientists aged them using the centre of their eyes, which forms before birth and never changes.
The oldest one they measured was nearly four hundred years old.
They grow about one centimetre a year.
They aren't ready to have babies until they're around a hundred and fifty.
They swim slower than you walk.
Many are half blind, because a parasite lives on their eyes.
And yet... remains of polar bears have been found in their stomachs.
Their meat is toxic. Eaten fresh, it can make people stagger like they're drunk.
Somewhere in the dark, one of them was already old... when the Titanic sank.
